repositories.description: Systematic literature review pipeline: dispatches ten retrieval engines (arXiv, OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, Crossref, PubMed) with graceful degradation, deduplicates by DOI/arXiv/OpenAlex ID or title hash, then runs TF-IDF embeddings, NMF topic models and citation networks into an auto-written bibliometric manuscript.

repositories.name: template_madlib
repositories.description: Config-driven manuscript generator with auditable token provenance: a single manuscript/config.yaml hydrates a full IMRAD paper plus PNG figures, token-inventory JSON and PDF/HTML/slide renders, with seeded-digest determinism and every substituted word traced back to its source YAML path.

repositories.name: template_methods_paper
repositories.description: Scaffold for methods and protocol papers where the contribution is the procedure language itself: frozen-dataclass Python model compiles method plans to JSON, CSV worklists and Mermaid DAGs through four validation gates, with unit/dimensional safety, Kahn-order determinism and SHA-256 provenance hash chains.

repositories.name: template_newspaper
repositories.description: Print-ready newspaper generator in pure Python: renders an 11x17 US tabloid PDF (The Triplicate) from YAML masthead, stories and ads using ReportLab, Pillow halftone engravings and matplotlib charts, with flowing multi-column layout and broadsheet/tabloid trim swapped by data edit alone.

repositories.name: template_pools_rules_tools
repositories.description: Research-infrastructure scaffold wiring three resource pools (fonds, rules, tools) into one self-validating Python pipeline: typed manifests with schema-versioned receipts, fail-closed jsonschema validation, soft vs strong rule checks, tool entrypoint discovery, and a generated manuscript with matplotlib figures.

repositories.name: template_prose_project
repositories.description: Scaffold for manuscript and editorial projects — runs prose quality gates over a draft: readability metrics, structure validation, and BibTeX citation integrity, with thresholds from manuscript/config.yaml producing manuscript_report.json, checks.json, review_report.md, and word-count/readability/citation-density plots.

repositories.name: template_redacted_report
repositories.description: Scaffold for controlled disclosure of sensitive reports (FOIA, intelligence, legal) — applies classification ceilings, source protection, and reviewer gates, then emits redaction_audit.json and release_ledger.json with SHA-256 hashes while sanitized text stays in memory. Validators flag residual markers and mosaic risk.

repositories.name: template_registered_report
repositories.description: Scaffold for registered reports, preregistrations, and replications — freezes hypotheses, outcomes, exclusion rules, and the analysis plan into a hash-stamped ledger, logs every deviation, and audits claims so confirmatory and exploratory results stay separate. Emits hypothesis-outcome maps, analysis DAGs, deviation timelines, permutation tests.

repositories.name: template_search_project
repositories.description: Scaffold for literature review and evidence synthesis — searches arXiv, Crossref, and local corpora, deduplicates hits, enriches abstracts and fulltext, then runs local Ollama (gemma3:4b) per-paper and corpus-level synthesis into references.bib, reading_report.md, corpus.json, and coverage plots. Deterministic caching, pinned seeds.

repositories.name: template_sia
repositories.description: Evaluation harness scaffold for self-improvement agents (SIA) — runs a Meta to Target to Feedback loop across generations, scores runs on the mini_classify task with split public/private data to catch overfitting, and replays recorded_generations fixtures for deterministic reruns. Python, uv, pytest; swap your agent into src/loop.py.

repositories.name: template_storybook
repositories.description: Scaffold for illustrated picture books — renders a full-page PDF storybook from content/story.yaml using ReportLab and procedural graphics, with per-page scripts you can add, remove, or reorder, plus PNG plates, contact sheet, and render manifest. Demo storybook: Tessa the tetrahedron and Ciro the cube.

repositories.name: template_template
repositories.description: Reference exemplar of the docxology template family — a self-describing repo whose manuscript regenerates from its own codebase: introspection walks the YAML pipeline DAG and module inventory, a metrics engine fills tokens, and scripts draw architecture diagrams. Ships the multi-platform publishing workflow (Zenodo, PyPI, IPFS, arXiv).

repositories.name: template_textbook
repositories.description: Project scaffold for book-length manuscripts — declare parts, chapters, labs, and question banks in one config.yaml and get auto-numbering, cross-references, deterministic matplotlib figures and Mermaid diagrams, and PDF/HTML/EPUB/DOCX output. A structural-contract pytest suite; uv-managed.

repositories.name: thalia
repositories.description: THALIA is a typed agentic harness pairing DSPy compiler-driven optimization with layered memory — Inspector, BM25/embedding hybrid Retriever, cited Reasoner, append-only SQLite memory gate, and MIPRO/GEPA-style config search. Deterministic, zero-mock pytest suite, evaluated on LongMemEval_S.
